g.title: worked_example
g.text: A multi-part user input traced through all five stages of the Safety Critic

g.title: input
g.text: Nightmare context: "Being chased by a shadowy figure through a dark forest"
"This exercise is weird, but okay — I find a heavy branch on the ground
and pick it up. Then I just hide behind a tree and hope it goes away."

g.title: segments
g.text: "I find a heavy branch and pick it up"
"I just hide behind a tree and hope it goes away"

g.title: filtered
g.text: "I find a heavy branch and pick it up"
"I just hide behind a tree and hope it goes away"

g.title: constraint
g.text: Constraint Message → injected into LLM prompt
The user showed adaptive behavior by finding a branch
to defend themselves (Environmental Mastery). Acknowledge this.
However, the user then reverted to avoidance (hiding,
hoping the threat passes). This reinforces passivity.
Guide toward using the branch actively —
Environmental Mastery (using the branch as a tool/barrier).

g.title: output
g.text: is_safe = False | Constraint injected into next LLM prompt | LLM generates corrected response
